newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bus plunges into lake, 55 feared killed.
newsitem.headline: Indian bus plunges into lake, 55 feared killed.

text.p: Fifty-five people were feared killed when the bus they were travelling in plunged into a lake in the southern Indian state of Karnataka on Wednesday, police said.
The state's deputy police chief D. Madiyal told Reuters rescuers were combing the lake in the Chitradurga district for bodies. Five passengers swam to safety, he said.
